summary: Adds evals.json for the debug-loop skill with five evals (vague login failure, pasted traceback, red tests after merge, trivial typo fast path, perf regression), each with a fixture path, prompt, and expectations. Also adds the csv-report fixture: a BOM-prefixed sales CSV, a report.py that opens files as plain utf-8 and reads row["region"], two clean test CSVs, and a two-test suite that passes on the clean data.

claims.text: Five evals defined, ids 0-4, each naming a fixture directory under evals/fixtures/.
sales-2026-08.csv header starts with a UTF-8 BOM before 'region'.
report.py opens with encoding="utf-8" (not utf-8-sig), so BOM stays in first header key and row["region"] raises KeyError.
Test suite uses only BOM-free CSVs, so it stays green while the export crashes, matching the eval prompt.
Eval 1 traceback cites report.py line 20 and line 12, which match the fixture's line numbers.
Fixtures expired-sessions, pricing-regression, slug-typo, slow-enrichment exist with the behavior the expectations describe.

risks.note: Intentional fixture bug: no BOM-aware decoding; also float(row["amount"]) has no guard for blank or malformed amounts.
Fast-path expectation 'about three lines' is fuzzy; grader may score inconsistently on brief length.

least_confident: Whether the BOM byte in sales-2026-08.csv survives git and the diff rendering intact, since the chunk shows only the visible character at line 134.
